official_sources.title: GDAL zonal-statistics pixel inclusion modes
official_sources.finding: GDAL zonal statistics supports default rasterization, all-touched inclusion and fractional pixel coverage; fractional mode weights cells by polygon coverage while all-touched includes every intersected cell equally.
official_sources.limitation: Minimum and maximum statistics are not coverage-weighted, so tiny edge intersections can still control extrema unless an explicit interior-support rule is applied.

official_sources.title: GDAL ALL_TOUCHED edge and ordering semantics
official_sources.finding: Without ALL_TOUCHED, polygon pixels are generally selected by centre-point rules; with ALL_TOUCHED every touched pixel is included and feature order can determine edge values where polygons meet.
official_sources.limitation: ALL_TOUCHED is a sensitivity mode, not an automatic accuracy improvement, and overlapping features require deterministic ordering.

official_sources.title: GDAL warp source and destination NoData controls
official_sources.finding: Source NoData and validity masks are excluded from interpolation; destination NoData initializes uncovered output and can be recorded in the output dataset.
official_sources.limitation: Intrinsic and explicit NoData settings must be reconciled; disabling them or omitting destination NoData can create false valid cells.

official_sources.title: GDAL target-aligned pixels do not guarantee source-grid alignment
official_sources.finding: The target-aligned-pixels option makes output extent coordinates integer multiples of target resolution but does not necessarily align the output grid with the input grid.
official_sources.limitation: Exact source-origin, resolution and geotransform comparison remains mandatory before claiming native-cell preservation.

official_sources.title: GDAL overview selection can bypass requested resampling
official_sources.finding: During downsampling GDAL may automatically use the closest existing overview, whose creation resampling method can differ from the method requested for the warp; selecting no overview forces base-raster use.
official_sources.limitation: Overview pyramids can smooth or alter extrema and must not silently feed parcel height-difference results.

official_sources.title: PROJ operation search with grid, accuracy and ballpark filters
official_sources.finding: projinfo can restrict candidate operations by area, spatial relation and desired accuracy, discard operations with missing grids, and hide ballpark transformations.
official_sources.limitation: A listed operation is not sufficient unless its required grids are actually available and its area of use covers the target.

official_sources.title: pyproj only-best and unavailable-operation controls
official_sources.finding: Transformer can disallow ballpark operations, require a minimum accuracy and fail when the best known operation cannot be used; TransformerGroup exposes whether the best operation is available and lists unavailable operations.
official_sources.limitation: Runtime acceptance must record the selected operation, reported accuracy, grid availability and area of interest rather than merely completing without exception.

official_sources.title: PROJ authority axis-order compliance
official_sources.finding: PROJ respects the axis order defined by the CRS authority; projinfo should be used to inspect axis order where longitude/latitude or easting/northing assumptions are uncertain.
official_sources.limitation: An axis swap can produce plausible but wrong coordinates, so exact target-range and round-trip checks remain mandatory.
